summary: TikTok's launch page for its free, open-source variable font: almost everything is on black and in motion, built like a feed. A hover-reactive italic wordmark, a statement revealed word by word over phone-format clips, an inflated 3D glyph ball beside the style list, a glyph line sliding across metric lines, bursts of real TikTok clips with the font as text overlay, a neon-yellow slider tester, a language picker that swaps one giant word, and a footer with Google Fonts/GitHub links and contributor logos.

instances.look: Thin top bar on black: TikTok note logo top-left (links #home) and a white rounded 'Free Font ↘' pill top-right linking to Google Fonts; round '↘' scroll buttons and a single changing letter (A, C, G, T, V, Z…) at the right edge recur through the page

Full black screen with 'TikTok Sans' centred in white Light italic at ~173px; tiny italic corner labels 'Exceptional vibes [ • ]' bottom-left and 'Variable Font—No. 1' bottom-right; a large 'A' at the bottom-right edge
instances.ux: On load the name fades in from grey and condensed to white; each letter is its own focusable span whose wght/wdth respond to the pointer
instances.learn: Make each letter of the wordmark individually reactive: the hero is calm until the pointer touches it

reconstruction.layout: 1440×900 black; name centred at y≈360; corner labels 12px from the bottom edges; nav pill top-right
reconstruction.typography: Name ~173px TikTok Sans wght 300, wdth 100, skewed -10° per letter; labels ~10px italic
reconstruction.behaviour: Intro fade/grey→white over ~1.5s; per-letter hover changes font-variation-settings (wght, wdth) with easing

instances.look: The sentence 'The font you've seen all / over the app is now / free for everyone!' centred over a portrait phone-format video (a hand with a ring); words already passed are white, the rest grey and partly overlapping the clip; followed by 'Great for ® Web—App—TV—Brand'
instances.ux: Scrolling lights up the sentence word by word while short vertical clips appear behind it
instances.learn: Scrub the announcement word by word on scroll over phone-shaped clips: the platform's own format carries the message

instances.look: 'A raw and expressive variable font by TikTok' top-left; an inflated black 3D ball printed with white glyphs (a, #, ¢) turning on the left; on the right four style names each set in itself: 'Regular', 'Italic', 'Expanded' (bold extended), 'Condensed', framed by L-shaped corner marks; floating glyphs (¢, *) around; '14 Styles & 1000+ Glyphs' follows
instances.ux: Videos loop (eyes, balloon ball); the style list may step on scroll
instances.learn: Four words, each in the style it names, cover the axes (weight, slant, width) faster than a full style grid

instances.look: Bursts of overlapping TikTok clips on black where the font appears as the on-video text: 'PARIS AU PRINTEMPS' in yellow over the Eiffel Tower, a boot clip, a muralist painting, a kid running with 'RUN *RUN' and 'STOMP the stomp', a coffee poster, nails, a sweater; floating giant glyphs (®, outlined ©, 3D keycaps '@' '&'), a vertical '19—98' and a ticker 'The official TikTok font now released * Instant read ‡ Sun drenched views º Raw font pleasure for you ® Real curiosity ^ Exceptional vibes'
instances.ux: Clips autoplay muted and shift with scroll; the ticker scrolls continuously; ↘ buttons jump to the next section
instances.learn: For a platform font, the best in-use proof is the platform's own content: show creators' clips with the font as their captions

instances.look: Full-screen neon yellow-green panel: an outlined alignment button top-left, the current style name 'Light Italic' top-centre, a colour (droplet) button top-right, three hairline sliders with black pill thumbs, and a huge editable sample 'doing my thing—making stuff happen' in black Light Italic
instances.ux: Slider 1 (0–35) scrubs through the styles and updates the label; slider 2 (-12–10) sets tracking; slider 3 (88–250) sets size; buttons cycle alignment and background colour; click the text to type; selection highlights in TikTok red
instances.learn: Draw the sliders as hairlines with pill thumbs and drop all numeric labels: a tester can feel like part of the brand, not a form

reconstruction.behaviour: input[type=range] 0–35 step .01 → interpolated style (wght/wdth/slnt) and name label; -12–10 step .1 → letter-spacing px; 88–250 → font-size px; colour button cycles data-bg-color presets; alignment button cycles left/centre/right
reconstruction.content: Casual creator phrase 'doing my thing—making stuff happen'

instances.variantDefinition: A wheel or list of language names beside one giant word; choosing a language (or letting it auto-cycle) swaps the word for its translation, so a single display line demonstrates coverage one language at a time.
instances.look: '460+ languages' label top-right; a vertical drum of language names on the left (Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, English, Greek, Turkish, German, Italian, Romanian, Dutch, Malay, Vietnamese) fading toward the ends with the active one bold white; the translation of 'create' ('Crear', 'Erstellen') huge in white, bleeding off the right edge
instances.ux: Click a language (or let it cycle) to swap the giant word; the list scrolls to centre the active item
instances.learn: Translate one meaningful verb ('create') instead of a pangram: each language shows its own diacritics and word shape at display size
